data.exact_reserve_text: For context, during 2024 the actual incurred development was GBP 28.3m against expected development of GBP 8.4m. We have increased reserves on all years. The 2022 and prior gross reserves were increased by GBP 21.3m, partially offset by increased reinsurance recoveries of GBP 4.7m.

prior_year_events.event_name: Increase in severe claims - US Healthcare professional liability
prior_year_events.impact_description: Material increase in frequency of severe loss in healthcare professional liability portfolio leading to increased reserves on prior years.
A number of aviation war claims agreed for settlement on an ex-gratia basis; increased reserves recorded.

prior_year_events.event_name: US General Liability contractor portfolio adverse development
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development predominantly in respect of two contracts leading to strengthened gross and net reserves for 2022 and prior years.

named_events.loss_description: Largest individual gross loss ($21.6m) which impacted the Marine Reinsurance portfolio.
Industry events totalling around $50bn; Syndicate total net loss to these events is less than $25m and the impact to the Syndicate was less than $25m, within net cat budget.
Expected loss was known when reserves were set; not expected to materially deteriorate the ultimate result for the year of account.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2024 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were 368.826m (report currency). Analysis of the claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development (strengthening) of approximately 72.8m, driven largely by increased severity in the healthcare professional liability portfolio, aviation war-related settlements and adverse development in certain US general liability contracts. The Syndicate explicitly notes increases to 2022-and-prior gross reserves (GBP21.3m) and specified gross increases for aviation-related reserves (GBP12.8m) and US GL (GBP5.4m). Current-year catastrophe events (Hurricane Milton and Helene, Los Angeles wildfires) produced losses within the Syndicate's budgets and did not materially change the prior-year reserve trajectory.
raw_causal_phrases: a material increase in frequency of severe loss in our healthcare professional liability portfolio
Aviation War - The increase in reserve is GBP 12.8m gross, GBP 5.1m net of reinsurance.
We continue to see adverse development of claims predominantly in respect of two contracts and have strengthened gross (and net) reserves by GBP 5.4m for the 2022 and prior years.
The 2022 and prior gross reserves were increased by GBP 21.3m, partially offset by increased reinsurance recoveries of GBP 4.7m.
data.data_quality_notes: Primary calculations use the report's presentation currency (USD). Some narrative reserve movements are quoted in GBP (document mixes GBP and USD in discussion). Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (cumulative gross claims triangle) on page 39 (triangle units are in thousands). Narrative provides GBP gross movement figures for specific items (e.g. GBP21.3m increase to 2022-and-prior gross reserves) which are in a different currency to the financial statement presentation; these have been reported verbatim in event/lob details but the aggregated prior-year development was computed from the gross triangle in the report currency. RITC activity (SPA 6131) is mentioned; triangular data may be influenced by reinsurance treaty activity but no RITC distortions preventing triangle use were identified.
